parse_audio_segments: parse an audio file path with start and end timestamps into an Audio object
compute_audio_overlap: compute the overlap fraction or IOU between two audio segments using IntersectMethods
postprocess_mining_results: filter and deduplicate audio mining results by score threshold and max overlap
load_audio_from_tsv: load audio waveforms from TSV manifest lines with optional GPU and fp16 support
read_and_resample_audio: read an audio file from disk and resample it to a target sampling rate
